attractions.name: Eiffel Tower
attractions.description: Iconic iron tower offering panoramic views over Paris including the Seine River, Haussmann rooftops, and distant monuments. 2nd Floor access available.
attractions.entry_fee: Approx. INR 3,500–6,500 depending on level access

attractions.name: Seine River Cruise
attractions.description: Relaxing cruise along the Seine River with illuminated bridges, riverside architecture, and glowing monuments creating a cinematic and timeless atmosphere.

attractions.name: Louvre
attractions.description: World's largest art museum and historic monument

attractions.name: Jardin de Tuileries
attractions.description: A historic 16th-century royal garden, now a serene cultural oasis between the Louvre and Place de la Concorde

attractions.name: Sacre Coeur
attractions.description: A sacred basilica atop Montmartre, symbolizing peace and offering breathtaking views of Paris

attractions.name: River Seine Illumination cruise
attractions.description: A Seine River Illumination cruise offers a magical, romantic vantage of Paris's most famous monuments beautifully lit at night

attractions.name: Disneyland Paris
attractions.description: Magical theme park resort with two parks — Disneyland Park and Walt Disney Studios Park — featuring rides, themed zones, live entertainment, and the Disney Tales of Magic nighttime show.

attractions.name: Place de la Concorde
attractions.description: Bustling intersection connecting the Champs-Élysées to the Seine River

attractions.name: Arc de Triomphe
attractions.description: Iconic monument standing at the center of Place Charles de Gaulle offering one of the city's most recognizable views with rooftop access.

attractions.name: Trocadero
attractions.description: Famous square and gardens offering the best panoramic views of the Eiffel Tower

attractions.name: Louvre Museum
attractions.description: One of the world's most iconic cultural experiences housed in a magnificent former royal palace. Features the Mona Lisa, Venus de Milo, and Winged Victory of Samothrace among countless masterpieces.

attractions.name: Notre Dame Cathedral
attractions.description: Gothic cathedral with flying buttresses on Île de la Cité

attractions.name: Sacré-Cœur Basilica
attractions.description: Iconic basilica perched high above Paris in Montmartre offering breathtaking panoramic sunset views. Musicians, artists, and travelers gather along the staircase and hilltop viewpoints.

attractions.name: Montmartre
attractions.description: Artistic and atmospheric neighborhood with cobblestone streets, ivy-covered cafés, painters' squares, old stairways, and glowing street lamps giving it a romantic timeless character.

attractions.name: Galeries Lafayette
attractions.description: Famous Parisian department store with a vast array of luxury brands, fashion, cosmetics and gourmet foods and a rooftop terrace with panoramic views of the city

attractions.name: Seine River Illumination Cruise
attractions.description: Evening cruise showing illuminated Paris monuments

attractions.name: Jardin des Tuileries
attractions.description: Elegant royal garden with manicured pathways and fountains

attractions.name: Seine River
attractions.description: Iconic river running through Paris, perfect for a relaxed evening stroll with atmospheric views and Parisian sunsets.

attractions.name: Champs-Élysées
attractions.description: Paris' most famous avenue lined with luxury boutiques, cafés, theaters, and grand architecture.

attractions.name: Notre-Dame Cathedral
attractions.description: Iconic Gothic cathedral, exterior visit recommended.

attractions.name: Tootbus Paris Night Bus Tour
attractions.description: Panoramic night bus tour of illuminated Paris, departing from Place du Carrousel near the Louvre. Audio guide available.

attractions.name: Tuileries Garden
attractions.description: Elegant pathways, fountains, sculptures, and perfectly manicured gardens creating a peaceful contrast to the busy city. Tree-lined pathways stretch toward Place de la Concorde.

attractions.name: Galeries Lafayette Haussmann
attractions.description: Iconic grand department store in Paris offering luxury fashion, accessories, and Parisian shopping experience.

attractions.name: Printemps Haussmann
attractions.description: Elegant department store in Paris for shopping.

attractions.name: Sainte-Chapelle
attractions.description: Gothic royal chapel renowned for its towering stained-glass walls in shades of sapphire, ruby, and gold.

attractions.name: Moulin Rouge
attractions.description: Iconic cabaret venue in Montmartre with vibrant performances, live music, and theatrical atmosphere.
attractions.hours: Evening shows typically from 9:00 PM onwards

safety_tips.tip: Keep your belongings secure, especially in busy areas and train stations.
Be mindful of luggage while boarding trains or during transfers.
Stick to well-lit areas if stepping out late.
Avoid carrying large amounts of cash — cards are widely accepted.
Always follow pedestrian signals when crossing roads.

transport_options.description: Extensive underground metro network covering all major Paris attractions. Key lines include Line 1, Line 4, and Line 13.

High-speed international train service arriving at Paris Gare du Nord from London and other European cities.

transport_options.description: Paris has one of Europe's best metro systems with excellent connectivity across the city. RER trains connect airports, Disneyland Paris, and outer districts. Google Maps works very accurately for metro navigation.
Many Paris neighbourhoods are best explored on foot, especially Montmartre, Le Marais, Latin Quarter, and around the Eiffel Tower & Seine River. Comfortable walking shoes are highly recommended.
Sightseeing bus route through the city's historic districts, riverside avenues, and iconic landmarks.
Train connection from Charles de Gaulle Airport into central Paris toward Gare du Nord. Approx. 40–45 mins travel time.
